risk_note: RV2 by path rules for funds BR (refs BR-WDR-30). Admin kill switches page: lists every registered switch in four groups in registry order with current / default / differs-from-default, the permission points and read-only rows; a switch can be changed only when the account holds one of the row's permissions; each change is confirmed (before / after, optional note up to 200 characters), passes the shared totp step-up modal and sends one PUT with X-Step-Up-Token, the page applies the server's row; withdraw.auto_payout.enabled can only be turned off; enum switches go through the same confirmation; 10003 asks for step-up again, 10403 / 20001 / 20902 keep the value, a write with an unknown result (network, parse, 5xxxx) is shown as unknown and re-read, a row stays unconfirmed until a reload succeeds, never re-sent. Not done (decided): the off-reason linked write. Rule tests by Codex in two calls (44 tests; round 2 after the Claude spec-test review S1: a generic text pattern rejected board wording), red on the test machine (red/2); the orchestrator only re-formatted one frozen file with prettier in the spec commit. Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds (round 2: a TextArea update loop and visual fixes from the screen-by-screen comparison with the frozen boards; round 3: the Codex review S2 on unknown results). Test machine verify-fast/4 and browser/4 green. Reviews: Codex only (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.
